questions.enonce_markdown:
The table below shows approximate values of a variable $y$ corresponding to certain values of another variable $x$.

| $x$ | 10 | 20 | 35 | 50 | 60 | 80 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| $y$ | 3.47 | 5.50 | 10.47 | 20.89 | 33.11 | 79.43 |

By drawing a suitable linear graph, verify that these values of $x$ and $y$ satisfy approximately a relationship of the form $y = ab^x$.

Using your graph, find approximate values of the constants $a$ and $b$, giving the answers correct to 2 decimal places. (10 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
**Reduction to linear form.** Take logarithms to base $10$ of $y = ab^x$:

$$\lg y = \lg a + x\lg b.$$

This is of the form $Y = mX + c$ with $Y = \lg y$, $X = x$, gradient $m = \lg b$ and intercept $c = \lg a$. So if $y = ab^x$ holds approximately, the graph of $\lg y$ against $x$ is (approximately) a straight line.

**Table of values** (4 decimal places kept, 2 decimal places plotted):

| $x$ | 10 | 20 | 35 | 50 | 60 | 80 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| $y$ | 3.47 | 5.50 | 10.47 | 20.89 | 33.11 | 79.43 |
| $\lg y$ | 0.5403 | 0.7404 | 1.0199 | 1.3199 | 1.5200 | 1.9000 |

**Graph.** Draw axes with $x$ horizontal from $0$ to $80$ (for example $1\ \mathrm{cm}$ per $10$ units) and $\lg y$ vertical from $0$ to $2.0$ (for example $2\ \mathrm{cm}$ per $0.2$ unit; the vertical axis must be extended down to $\lg y = 0$ at $x=0$ to read the intercept). Plot the six points $(10, 0.54)$, $(20, 0.74)$, $(35, 1.02)$, $(50, 1.32)$, $(60, 1.52)$, $(80, 1.90)$ and draw the line of best fit. All six points lie on or extremely close to one straight line: the gradients between successive points are $0.0200,\ 0.0186,\ 0.0200,\ 0.0200,\ 0.0190$, which are practically constant. This verifies that $y$ and $x$ satisfy approximately a relation of the form $y = ab^x$.

**Reading the constants.** Take two well-separated points on the line, $(10, 0.54)$ and $(80, 1.90)$:

$$\text{gradient} = \lg b = \frac{1.90 - 0.54}{80 - 10} = \frac{1.36}{70} \approx 0.0194, \qquad b = 10^{0.0194} \approx 1.046 \approx 1.05.$$

The vertical intercept (at $x = 0$) is $\lg a = 0.54 - 10(0.0194) \approx 0.346$, hence

$$a = 10^{0.346} \approx 2.22.$$

$$\boxed{a \approx 2.22, \qquad b \approx 1.05}$$

so $y \approx 2.22 \times (1.05)^x$, more precisely $y \approx 2.22\,(1.046)^x$ (a least-squares fit of the six points gives $a = 2.22$, $b = 1.046$). Check with the table at $x = 50$: $2.2227 \times 1.0458^{50} \approx 20.9$ (least-squares values), in agreement with $y = 20.89$.
